strings.en:
{0b:08}【 Asroitian B 】{0b:09}
Fancy word ya know there.{1a}But lemme tell ya, when that individuality
gets formed, the country and the land
have more than a little to do with it.{1a}For example, a merchant livin' in the city
ain't gonna know how us farmers ache
for rain,{1a}and us, we don't get how folks in the
city feel neither. We can pretend to, at
least.{1a}If I'd been born in the city, or a bleak
desert, or some hot, hot island in the
south, I'd be a whole different me. How I
think, how I live, that individuality of{1a}mine too.{0c:2b1f23080001fe}
strings.tl: Fancy word ya know there. // But lemme tell ya, when that individuality gets formed, the country and the land have more than a little to do with it. // For example, a merchant livin' in the city ain't gonna know how us farmers ache for rain, // and us, we don't get how folks in the city feel neither. We can pretend to, at least. // If I'd been born in the city, or a bleak desert, or some hot, hot island in the south, I'd be a whole different me.
